label: Rerun Job
mcp_tool_description: Rerun a finished CloudBolt job, or resume a paused one, exactly like the Rerun and Resume buttons on its job page. Give the job's global id (JOB-...) or numeric id, and rerun_job_mode: rerun (the default) or resume. rerun (the v3 jobs clone endpoint): the new job reuses the old job's parameters, resource, servers and arguments and runs the current plug-in code. Use it to rerun a failed blueprint build item (a plug-in job) on the existing resource after syncing a fix, instead of tearing down and ordering again. It refuses a job that is still active or paused, one already rerun (it names the latest rerun), and any job CloudBolt's own rerun rule refuses: non-admins can rerun only failed jobs; admins can also rerun successful plug-in, provision, blueprint and decommission jobs. Returns newJobId to poll with fetch_job_log. The caller needs CloudBolt's job.rerun permission on the job (admins and the job's owner have it). resume (the v3 jobs resume endpoint, CloudBolt admins only): sets a PAUSED job back to RUNNING. A blueprint deployment pauses on a failed build item when the blueprint has Pause Job on Failure and Misc Settings allows resuming failed blueprint jobs; resumed, it reruns the failed item with the current plug-in code and carries on with the next build items, so give it the paused deploy_blueprint job, not the failed item. It refuses a job that is not PAUSED (naming a paused parent if there is one) and a deployment whose failed item is still being rerun. Returns jobId and jobStatus; poll jobId with fetch_job_log.
